{{Top|leg}}
The '''Core Worlds Security Act''' was a law instituted during the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It effectively heightened the security of the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], and reassigned various military and security assets to the protection of planets such as [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], to ensure that they were safe from the advancing war machines of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. Opponents of the law argued that it was enacted to appease business and financial supporters in the Core, and left the far-flung worlds in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] undefended against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
